# V2-01 — cross-module requests (do not edit these paths from V2-01)

V2-01 defined shared contracts. Implementors / consumers should adapt as follows without editing `shared/**` themselves (except by filing a follow-up to V2-01).

| Owner | Ask |
|-------|-----|
| **V2-02** | Implement `MfaReauthPort` (wrap `MfaReauthService` with `Duration`). Override `PatientAccessPort.isErAssigned` for assignee-column ACL. Ship staff UI at `/identity/staff` (nav already links there). |
| **V2-03** | Implement `PatientQrPort`; use `mediflow.patient.qr-token-ttl`. |
| **V2-06** | Depend on `com.mediflow.shared.port.LabOrderPort` only; delete or deprecate `clinical.consultation.port.LabOrderPort` + its NoOp. |
| **V2-07** | Resolve brands / interactions via `com.mediflow.shared.port.DrugDictionaryPort`; gate e-sign with `MfaReauthPort`. |
| **V2-08** | `@Component` / `@Primary` `LabOrderPort` that creates a real `lab_order` (replaces shared NoOp). |
| **V2-09** | Make pharmacy dictionary implement `com.mediflow.shared.port.DrugDictionaryPort` (records nested on the shared interface). Keep pharmacy package types as adapters if needed during transition. |
| **V2-10** | Implement `AdherenceQueryPort` so patient home tile fills in. |
| **Module UIs** | Prefer `layout/fragments/*` + CSS variables in `static/css/tokens.css` / `app.css`. Optional richer home tiles: file a V2-01 follow-up to wire `th:replace` once your `templates/<module>/home-tiles.html` exists. |

No secrets, Docker, or test-infra changes requested.
